title: Android Editor crash on resource preview generation for GDExtension resource (analytics report)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6.stable (analytics report for Godot Editor on Google Play)
- Didn't check other versions

### System information

Android 13 & 16 Beta, various devices

### Issue description

This is a copy of a Google Play crash report for the Godot Editor on Android after it was updated to 4.6.stable yesterday.

We don't have more info than just the stacktrace, so we have to work from that.

Report for maintainers with access: https://play.google.com/console/u/0/developers/5310120689138741555/app/4972363226496209566/vitals/crashes/e6008865b9b5a061bad317e1a3c6e10e/details?days=28&isUserPerceived=true&versionCode=40600500
